The '''Jedi sanctuary''' was a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] structure built by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on the [[aquatic moon of Delriss]]. It was more than a kilometer underwater and was attached to an undersea ridge. The sanctuary was abandoned after the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. The sanctuary contained multiple rooms, including a hangar bay and a library, which eventually flooded.<ref name="CotG" />
